items.item: The claim that a long-lived reader blocks reclaim of versions it never directly reads (not just the one it does read) is the more surprising, stronger claim this topic measures, and it genuinely holds here: all four dead versions, not only the one visible to the reader, remain unreclaimed while it stays open.
